title: Caching Orchestra: interactive recommender and guardrail composer for batch/cache policies
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: PMs and SREs complain current batching/cache config pages are too scattered: knobs are in separate panels, recommendations are buried, and it's hard to understand global cost/latency impact before rolling out. Users need a single surface to explore recommended policies, see explainers for why a recommendation was chosen, tune tolerance (risk) via guardrails, simulate cost/latency tradeoffs, and create a staged rollout with canary/rollback settings.

Proposal: Build an interactive 'Caching Orchestra' panel inside the Console's Model Routes > Optimizations tab. The panel combines four coordinated areas: (1) Recommender Lens — ranked suggestions derived from workload signals (prefix-hit rate, seq length distribution, tail latency), (2) Thermostat Controls — a compact multi-knob for global aggressiveness and per-route override sliders, (3) Explainability Stream — natural-language rationale and a sparkline of historical simulations, and (4) Rollout Composer — quick canary steps, safety gates, and auto-rollback triggers.

Prototype notes: low-fidelity -> mid-fidelity Figma prototype with interactive knobs and an inline cost-simulator. Emphasis on micro-copy that explains uncertainty bands and cache-safety tradeoffs. Accessibility: keyboard focus order for thermostat controls and ARIA labels for recommendation badges. Performance: preview simulation uses sampled historical traces (server-side) — design shows a placeholder while the compute job runs.

Why different: previous designs focused on advisory cards or separate wizards. Caching Orchestra is a single, explorable canvas with both proactive recommendations and explicit safety primitives (guardrail toggles) to make rollouts auditable and reversible.

Deliverables: Figma prototype (interactive), annotated PRD page in Confluence, example rollout templates, copy deck for help center, microcopy for tooltips, and a short demo video for stakeholder review.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype covers Recommender Lens, Thermostat Controls, Explainability Stream, and Rollout Composer
Microcopy reviewed and approved by PM and Legal for non-misleading cost estimates
Prototype includes keyboard-accessible controls and ARIA attributes documented
Design spec includes API contract stubs for the cost-simulation endpoint and rollout steps
Handoff artifacts (tokens, spacings, components) exported and imported into Storybook-ready tokens
